{{Quote|I am General Threnoldt, commanding officer of the Imperial Reclamation Service. I understand you're familiar with us.|Threnoldt introduces himself to Imperial heroes|<ref name="Endless Horrors" />}}
'''Threnoldt''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as the [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanding officer]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire's]] [[Imperial Reclamation Service]], a [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|military]] unit charged with discovering and recovering ancient artifacts for [[Weapon/Legends|weaponization]] against the Empire's enemies. He held the [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] of [[General/Legends|general]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and [[Galactic War]]. Threnoldt organized the Empire's response to the threat posed by the ancient [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Soa]] on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]], a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. He later reported to the [[Dark Council]], the Empire's ruling body, on the threat posed by [[Lotek'k|emerging monstrosities]] from a [[Gree (species)/Legends|Gree]] [[hypergate]] on the [[Gree Enclave/Legends|Gree Enclave]] world of [[Asation]] in the first [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the Galactic War.

==Biography==
{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
Threnoldt was a [[General/Legends|general]] in the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire's]] [[Imperial Reclamation Service]].<ref name="Endless Horrors" /> He<ref name="New Frontiers" /> personally offered the leader of one of the service's expeditions, [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Barden Golah]], a position at the service's headquarters at the conclusion of Golah's mission on the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]<ref name="Golah Mail">{{TORcite|type=message|Tatooine Expedition Aftermath|Captain [[Barden Golah|Golah]]}}</ref> in [[3643 BBY]].<ref name="Year1">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> Golah's team had deployed to Tatooine to uncover ancient devices previously obtained by [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]].<ref name="Expedition into the Unknown">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Expedition into the Unknown|[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]}}</ref> Threnoldt was well acquainted with [[Darth Thanaton]] during the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord's]] brief reign on the [[Dark Council]] as head of the [[Sphere of Ancient Knowledge]] which oversaw the service.<ref name="Endless Horrors" />

[[File:Soa.png|thumb|left|255px|The danger posed to the Sith Empire by the ancient Rakatan warlord Soa (pictured) was so great that Threnoldt recruited a strike team to defeat the threat himself.]]
In approximately [[3640 BBY]],<ref name="Year2">{{TOR_dates|4}}</ref> the first [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of the [[Galactic War]], the Sith Empire launched an [[Invasion of Belsavis|invasion]] on the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]] planet [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. The Republic had constructed a [[Belsavis prison|prison]] there to house [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] most dangerous criminals but built it over the ruins of an existing ancient [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] prison.<ref name="Belsavis History">{{TORcite|type=codex|History of Belsavis Prison}}</ref> An Imperial [[bombing run]] on the planet revealed a new section of the ancient prison that had been sealed for over 20,000 years, which was known to its Rakatan builders as the [[Eternity Vault]]. Reclamation Service personnel translated Rakatan inscriptions and cross-referenced them with other such [[Writing/Legends|writings]] discovered throughout the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] that made reference to the vault's principal [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]], an ancient Rakatan [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] known as the "[[Soa|Infernal One]]." Threnoldt personally recruited a team of Imperial heroes to travel to Belsavis to defeat the ancient threat. After the mission was successfully completed and the warlord was defeated, Threnoldt mobilized additional personnel to explore the vault.<ref name="Endless Horrors" />

The following year,<ref name="Year3">{{TOR_updates|1.4}}</ref> the Sith Empire made its first contact with the [[Gree (species)/Legends|Gree]] [[Species/Legends|species]] who had reached out to the Imperials to assist them in suppressing a threat instigated by the [[Dread Host]], the forces of the rebellious [[Dread Masters]], on the [[Gree Enclave/Legends|Gree Enclave]] world of [[Asation]]. Threnoldt reported on the matter directly to the Dark Council.<ref name="New Frontiers" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|I've known fear before, and I know it today&mdash;any sane man would.|Threnoldt speaking to Imperial heroes of his concern over the threat posed by the Infernal One|<ref name="Endless Horrors" />}}
[[File:Lalatk.png|thumb|right|255px|When the Sith Empire made its initial contact with the Gree species (member of the species pictured), Threnoldt reported on the matter directly to the Dark Council.]]
Threnoldt was a diligent [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanding officer]] who proactively recruited Imperial heroes to confront the threat of the Eternity Vault's prisoners. He recognized and admired the admirable service of others such as Imperial [[Archaeologist/Legends|archaeologist]] [[Talos Drellik]] and expressed positive sentiments about working directly with the Dark Council. The general firmly believed the Sith Empire needed the Reclamation Service but was not hesitant to seek additional aid when needed. Prior to the Eternity Vault operation, he disbelieved the [[Sith Empire (Pre-Republic)|Sith]] had been governed by the Rakata on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]], the ancient [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith species]], [[Millennium/Legends|millennia]] prior. He was astute enough to recognize serious threats to the Empire when they arose but was not crippled by his fears. He was a [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="Threnoldt" /> [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="Male" /> with fair skin, [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]], and brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="Threnoldt" />

==Equipment==
Threnoldt wore an Imperial military [[Clothing/Legends|uniform]] which included a shoulder/upper chest guard and [[Bandolier/Legends|bandolier]], and he employed the standard gray-and-brown color scheme commonly displayed by personnel assigned to the Reclamation Service.<ref name="Threnoldt" />

==Behind the scenes==
Threnoldt appeared in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]]-[[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. He was the primary quest giver for all Imperial player classes for the game's first operation, the Eternity Vault.<ref name="Endless Horrors" />
